title: West Pakistan Conservation Restriction on Slaughter of Useful Animals Act 1956

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Conservation Restriction on Slaughter of Useful Animals Act 1956
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ACT VIII OF 1956
ACT VIII OF 1956
WEST
PAKISTAN CONSERVATION (RESTRICTION ON SLAUGHTER) OF USEFUL ANIMALS ACT, 1956
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑( I) This
Act may be called the West Pakistan Conservation (Restriction on Slaughter) of
Useful Animals Act, 1956.
(2) It extends to the Districts
of Bannu, Dera Ismail Khan, Hazara, Mardan, Kohat and Peshawar.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Conservation Restriction on Slaughter of Useful Animals Act 1956
sections.description:
Definitions

ACT VIII OF 1956
ACT VIII OF 1956
WEST
PAKISTAN CONSERVATION (RESTRICTION ON SLAUGHTER) OF USEFUL ANIMALS ACT, 1956
2. Definitions.‑In this Act unless there is anything repugnant
in the subject or context :‑
(a) "animal" means
and includes all bovine cattle and buffaloes ;
(b) "carcass" means
the dead body or any portion of the dead body of a useful animal as defined
hereafter ;
(c) "Director" means
the Director, Animal Husbandry, West Pakistan ;
(d) "Government"
means the Government of West Pakistan ;
(e) "slaughter" means
killing of an animal by cutting the throat ;
(f) "useful animal" means‑
(i) an animal below 3 years of
age ;
(ii) a male animal between 3
and 10 years of age fit for draught or breeding purposes ; or
(iii) a female animal between 3
and 10 years of age when in milk or fit for breeding purposes;
Provided, however, that useful animal shall not include any animal
which on account of any bodily injury, illness or otherwise is certified in
writing by a Magistrate, Gazetted Officer, ‑Naib‑Tahsildar,
Veterinary Assistant or Veterinary Assistant Surgeon in the case of animals
falling under (i) to be unlikely to live or to be fit when of proper age for
the purposes enumerated in (ii) or (iii) as the case may be, and in the case of
animals covered by (ii) and (iii) to be unfit for the pur poses enumerated
therein, respectively.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Conservation Restriction on Slaughter of Useful Animals Act 1956
sections.description:
Prohibition against slaughter of useful animals

ACT VIII OF 1956
ACT VIII OF 1956
WEST
PAKISTAN CONSERVATION (RESTRICTION ON SLAUGHTER) OF USEFUL ANIMALS ACT, 1956
3. Prohibition against slaughter of useful animals.‑(1) No
person shall slaughter a useful animal.
(2) If any person intending to
slaughter an animal secures the certificate referred to in the proviso to
clause (f) of section 2, such certificate shall be conclusive proof of the
facts stated therein unless it is proved that the certificate was secured
through fraud or mis representation of facts or collusion.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Conservation Restriction on Slaughter of Useful Animals Act 1956
sections.description:
Seizure and disposal of carcass

ACT VIII OF 1956
ACT VIII OF 1956
WEST
PAKISTAN CONSERVATION (RESTRICTION ON SLAUGHTER) OF USEFUL ANIMALS ACT, 1956
4. seizure and disposal of carcass.‑(1)
Any official of the Animal Husbandry Department of a rank above that of
Veterinary Assistant or Veterinary Assistant Surgeon, any gazetted officer of
the Govern ment, and any official of a slaughter house, may seize any useful
animal or a carcass, as the case may be, if he has reason to believe that such
animal is about to be is being or has
been, slaughtered in contravention of any provision of this Act.
(2) The person in possession of
an animal or a carcass mentioned in subsection (1) shall forthwith deliver the
same on demand to the officer taking action under that subsection.
(3) The officer taking action under subsection (1) shall
immediately report the matter to the officer‑in‑charge of the
nearest police station, who shall arrange to take into possession the animal or
the carcass, as the case may be, and if the said police officer is of the
opinion that the carcass is liable to speedy decay, he shall dispose of the
same by sale or otherwise as may appear to him to be most suitable.
(4) On
receiving such report the officer‑in‑charge of the police station
shall have the same powers of investigation as he may exercise in a cognizable
case, but shall not arrest without a warrant.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Conservation Restriction on Slaughter of Useful Animals Act 1956
sections.description:
Punishment

ACT VIII OF 1956
ACT VIII OF 1956
WEST
PAKISTAN CONSERVATION (RESTRICTION ON SLAUGHTER) OF USEFUL ANIMALS ACT, 1956
5. Punishment.‑(1) Whoever contravenes, or abets the contra vention
of any provision of this Act shall be punished with imprison ment of either
description for a term which may extend to 6 months or with fine not exceeding
Rs. 200 or with both.
(2) Whoever attempts to
contravene any provision of this Act or to cause such a contravention to be
committed and in such attempt does any act towards the commission of such
contravention, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a
term which may extend to 3 months or with fine not exceeding Rs. 100 or with
both.

Confiscation of useful animal or carcass

ACT VIII OF 1956
ACT VIII OF 1956
WEST
PAKISTAN CONSERVATION (RESTRICTION ON SLAUGHTER) OF USEFUL ANIMALS ACT, 1956
6. Confiscation of useful animal or carcass.‑The
Court trying any offence under this Act may direct that any useful animal in
respect of which it is satisfied that any offence was about to be committed
under this Act or the carcass of such animal, shall be confiscated to
Government and disposed of by sale or otherwise as may be prescribed.

Deposit of sums

7. Deposit of sums.‑All sums realised under subsection (3) of
section 4 or under section 6 shall be
deposited in the Government Treasury in
such manner as may be prescribed.

Exception

ACT VIII OF 1956
ACT VIII OF 1956
WEST
PAKISTAN CONSERVATION (RESTRICTION ON SLAUGHTER) OF USEFUL ANIMALS ACT, 1956
8. Exception.‑The
restrictions imposed by this Act on the slaughter of useful animals shall not
apply to animals slaughtered by Muslims for sacrificial purposes on the day of
I'd‑ul‑Azha and the two succeeding days.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Conservation Restriction on Slaughter of Useful Animals Act 1956
sections.description:
Repeal of north-west frontier province Ordinance I of 1955

ACT VIII OF 1956
ACT VIII OF 1956
WEST
PAKISTAN CONSERVATION (RESTRICTION ON SLAUGHTER) OF USEFUL ANIMALS ACT, 1956
10. Repeal of North‑West Frontier Province Ordinance I of 1955. (1) The North‑West
Frontier Province Conservation (Restriction on Slaughter) of Useful Animals
Ordinance, 1955 (hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance) is hereby
repealed.
(2) Notwithstanding the repeal
of the said Ordinance everything done, action taken, obligation, liability,
penalty or punishment incurred, inquiry or proceeding commenced, officer
appointed or person authorised, jurisdiction or power conferred, rule made and
order issued under any of the provisions of the said Ordinance shall be
continued, deemed to have been respectively done, taken, incurred, commenced,
appointed, authorized, conferred, made or issued under this Act.
